snippet.title: Taxi Chaos 2 | Physical Edition Announcement!
snippet.description:
TAXI CHAOS 2 IS GETTING A PHYSICAL RELEASE ON PS5 & NINTENDO SWITCH.
Pre-orders Open NOW at all major retailers.

Taxi Chaos 2 puts players back behind the wheel in a city where human drivers fight for relevance in streets ruled by au-tonomous TaxiBots. San Valeda reacts to every decision, shifting traffic, closing routes, and escalating chaos as each shift unfolds.

Inspired by classic arcade taxi driving with a modern twist, Taxi Chaos 2 blends fast pick up and play action with perma-nent progression and a structured shift system. Designed for short sessions and long term mastery, Taxi Chaos 2 delivers friendly chaos for families and returning fans!

#ps5 #nintendoswitch #arcadegames #retrogames #videogames #physicalmedia
